# RoomSlider

RoomSlider helps people find verified rooms, PGs, hostels, and flats for rent in Indore, India, and explore local services.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.roomslider.in/)
- [Rooms](https://www.roomslider.in/rooms)
- [Hostels](https://www.roomslider.in/hostels)
- [Flats](https://www.roomslider.in/flats)
- [PG](https://www.roomslider.in/pg)
- [Explore](https://www.roomslider.in/explore)
- [About](https://www.roomslider.in/about)
- [Contact](https://www.roomslider.in/contact)
- [Sitemap](https://www.roomslider.in/sitemap)
